releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes:
## What's new in 0.2.0

This release hardens the research protocol and ships the evaluation work that
came out of comparing this skill against other deep-research skills.

### Sources you cannot open are now handled by rule

The strongest primary sources are often behind a paywall or a bot wall. Until
now, the right response — record the failure, note the gap, and never pass a
snippet off as the original — was implied but not written down. It now is: a
blocked page is logged as an observation with its HTTP status, the gap goes into
the report as an availability caveat, and a claim whose only support is an
unreachable source is labelled `unknown` instead of quietly softened.

### The validator tells you how to fix a failure

A failed run used to get a code and a location. It now also gets one
"smallest safe fix" hint per actionable error — whether to re-key a claim, add a
second independent origin, or drop an unreachable reference — so a single
allowed correction is spent on the right change.

### A new warning for same-publisher "independence"

If an interpretive claim rests on several URLs that all belong to one publisher
(a wire story re-published across one outlet), the validator now warns with
`W_SAME_PUBLISHER`. It is a hint, not a failure: the check is a heuristic and
never blocks delivery.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes:
Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0).

## Better agent discovery and chain safety
- New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your
 custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate
 model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the
 local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It
 prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand.
- New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot
 (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`.

## Clearer recommendations
- The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line,
 plain-language description of what each agent does, so a suggestion can be judged
 without knowing the role by heart.
- A **dominance check** now closes model allocation: if another model is no worse on
 price, throughput and the trait-relevant capability (and strictly better on at
 least one), the dominated model is replaced — or must be justified in the "why"
 column (for example, a cross-provider fallback).

## Correct, dated vision data
- Image-input support is recorded with sources and dates: MiMo-V2.6 Flash/Pro and
 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash accept images. DeepSeek's Go id, lab version name and API
 request name are n…

en.headline: sogeisetsu ships meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 and 38 commits across 3 repos
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, `sogeisetsu` recorded **38 commits** across three repositories, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 21 own commits plus 17 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` covered daily-report fixes: inline Markdown rendering for AI summaries, deterministic truncation that took the daily-report success rate from 0% to 100%, disabling reasoning to fix empty-content truncation, JSON retry and model-parse fallback for AI summary failures, mock regression tests, and a new `AGENTS.md` alongside `scripts/daily/verify.mjs`. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, 15 own commits implemented the skill improvement plan (renderer, merge, validator, genres, docs), added a SenseNova capability gap analysis pinned to `5abde96`, made access-blocked handling explicit with validator hints and same-publisher warnings, and prepared the `0.2.0` release. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 2 own commits added `scripts/discover-agents.mjs` and `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs` and documented vision verification plus a Windows refresh path. Two releases shipped: `meld-deepresearch` `v0.2.0` and `opencode-go-model-picker` `v1.3.0`.

releaseNotes.summary: Hardens the research protocol and ships evaluation work comparing this skill against other deep-research skills. Blocked sources are now logged as observations with HTTP status, gaps become availability caveats, and unsupported claims are labelled `unknown`. The validator now reports how to fix a failure, not just a code and location.

Rolls up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work. Adds `scripts/discover-agents.mjs` for read-only agent listing with risky fallback-chain flags, and `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs` for a ~97% shorter snapshot digest with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. The recommendation table gains a role-overview column.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 meld-deepresearch v0.2.0，3 个仓库共 38 次提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共提交 **38 次**，无 PR、issue 或 review。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中 21 次本人提交，另有 17 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，主要围绕日报修复：AI 摘要内联 Markdown 渲染、确定性截断使日报成功率从 0% 升至 100%、关闭 reasoning 修复空内容截断、JSON 重试与模型解析回退、mock 回归测试，以及新增 `AGENTS.md` 与 `scripts/daily/verify.mjs`。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中 15 次本人提交实现了 skill 改进计划（renderer、merge、validator、genres、docs），新增 SenseNova 能力差距分析（固定于 `5abde96`），明确 access-blocked 处理并加入 validator 提示与同来源警告，并准备 `0.2.0` 发布。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 中 2 次本人提交新增 `scripts/discover-agents.mjs` 与 `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`，并记录视觉验证与 Windows 刷新路径。当日共发布两个版本：`meld-deepresearch` `v0.2.0` 与 `opencode-go-model-picker` `v1.3.0`。

releaseNotes.summary: 加固研究协议，并交付与其他 deep-research skill 对比得出的评估工作。被屏蔽来源现以 HTTP 状态记录为观察项，缺口转为可用性说明，无支撑的声明标记为 `unknown`。validator 现在会告知如何修复失败，而非仅给出代码与位置。
合并 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 的工作。新增 `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`，只读列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链；新增 `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`，提供约缩短 97% 的快照摘要，支持 `--ids`、`--trait`、`--json`。推荐表新增角色概览列。
